Swift Design

Decks from HTML, written by your agent.
slides.css: .s1-hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42fr 58fr; height: 100%; } .s1-panel { background: var(--accent); } .s1-copy { align-self: center; padding: 0 96px; } h1 { font-size: 120px; font-weight: 700; } .s1-caption { font-size: 40px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 24px; }

slides.html:
What Swift Design does

  • Agents read the schema and write deck JSON.
  • The server validates and renders every slide.
  • The user edits slides in the browser.
slides.css: .s2-page { padding: 96px 120px; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } h2 { font-size: 72px; font-weight: 600; } .s2-rule { width: 160px; height: 8px; background: var(--accent); margin: 28px 0 48px; } .s2-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr; gap: 96px; align-items: start; } .s2-columns li { font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 20px; } .s2-columns img { width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; }
